title: Three-Project Solution Scaffold + IKeychainProvider
keyDecisionsMade: IKeychainProvider.DeleteAsync returns Task (not Task<bool>) per agent mode spec — differs from cliq-cli which returns Task<bool>.

EncryptedFileKeychainProvider.GetWindowsMachineGuid() is annotated with [SupportedOSPlatform('windows')] to satisfy CA1416; OperatingSystem.IsWindows()/IsMacOS()/IsLinux() used everywhere for platform detection (not RuntimeInformation.IsOSPlatform()).
Program.cs is a minimal stub: CommandApp with no commands registered. No DI wiring yet.
ZapiCli.Core includes InternalsVisibleTo ZapiCli.Tests for future test access to internal members.
PlaceholderTests.cs uses explicit 'using Xunit;' — ImplicitUsings does not include xunit in this SDK configuration.

openQuestionsResolved.resolution: Followed defaultAssumption: SHA256(MachineName + MachineGuid + 'zapi-cli'). IV stored as first 12 bytes of .bin file; ciphertext + 16-byte GCM tag follows. Machine GUID sourced from registry on Windows, ioreg on macOS, /etc/machine-id on Linux.

Followed defaultAssumption: libsecret-1.so.0 via P/Invoke, CallingConvention.Cdecl, catches DllNotFoundException to activate fallback. TryCreate() probe validates D-Bus session is reachable before returning true.

issuesEncountered.issue: PlaceholderTests.cs initially missing 'using Xunit;' causing 2 CS0246 errors.
issuesEncountered.resolution: Added 'using Xunit;' to the top of PlaceholderTests.cs.

stateAfterStory.tests: N/A (no dotnet test run yet — placeholder test exists)

title: Output Contract + Error Infrastructure + Global Settings
keyDecisionsMade: exitCode in the error envelope uses [JsonPropertyName("exitCode")] to override SnakeCaseLower naming policy — ensures camelCase 'exitCode' not snake_case 'exit_code' in output.

JsonOutputWriter and InMemoryOutputWriter share the same Options instance (JsonOutputWriter.Options, internal static) and envelope types (JsonOutputWriter.SuccessEnvelope, ErrorEnvelope) so output format is identical between production and test.
InMemoryOutputWriter placed in ZapiCli.Core (not Tests) per story spec; made public so ZapiCli.Tests can use it without InternalsVisibleTo.

--version handled via explicit args check at top of Main() before CommandApp dispatch, following the cliq-cli pattern (Spectre.Console.Cli has no built-in --version for CommandApp without root command).

ErrorCodes.cs declares 16 static readonly string constants: the 12 from the agent mode spec, 3 from the story scope (SESSION_NOT_FOUND, SCOPE_NOT_FOUND, REGISTRY_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND), and INTERNAL_ERROR from the exception handler AC.
Logging configured at Warning level emitting to stderr only (AddConsole with LogToStandardErrorThreshold) so log lines never corrupt JSON stdout.

openQuestionsResolved.resolution: Followed defaultAssumption: IOutputWriter.WriteError has optional object? detail parameter; JsonOutputWriter omits the field when detail is null via [JsonIgnore(Condition = WhenWritingNull)].

title: AccountStore + PatAuthProvider + ZohoCorp Block
keyDecisionsMade: AccountEntry is a sealed record with init-only properties and required keyword for Name and TokenType; Domain defaults to 'zoho.com'. No token fields exist, guaranteeing tokens never appear in accounts.json.

AccountStore has a public DI constructor AccountStore(ILogger<AccountStore>) and an internal overload AccountStore(ILogger<AccountStore>, string configDir) for tests — uses InternalsVisibleTo(ZapiCli.Tests) already set in ZapiCli.Core.csproj.

Unix file permissions set via File.SetUnixFileMode(path, UserRead | UserWrite) in else branch after OperatingSystem.IsWindows() guard — the else satisfies [UnsupportedOSPlatform('windows')] without extra annotation.

Windows ACL via FileSystemAclExtensions.GetAccessControl() / FileInfo.SetAccessControl() inside [SupportedOSPlatform('windows')] private method TrySetWindowsAcl, wrapped in try/catch logging a Warning on failure. No NuGet package needed — System.Security.AccessControl is inbox for net10.0.
ZohoCorpGuard uses private const string BlockedSld = 'zohocorp' (compile-time constant per ADR-0005) — SLD-based detection covers all current and future datacenter TLDs automatically.
PatAuthProvider key format: 'zapi-cli:<accountName>:pat' (ADR-0004). GetTokenAsync throws ZapiCliException(AuthFailure, exitCode: 2) when token is null.
ZohoCorp startup warning uses ILogger<AccountStore> at Warning level — emitted on LoadAsync for any account whose email second-level domain matches 'zohocorp' (case-insensitive).

openQuestionsResolved.resolution: Windows ACL implemented via FileInfo.GetAccessControl()/SetAccessControl() using FileSystemAclExtensions (inbox in net10.0). Uses Environment.UserName for the access rule identity to avoid WindowsIdentity dependency. Wrapped in try/catch; failure logs Warning and does not fail the operation.

issuesEncountered.issue: Attempted to add System.Security.AccessControl 6.0.0 NuGet package.
issuesEncountered.resolution: NU1510 warning-as-error: package is unnecessary for net10.0 — types are inbox. Removed the PackageReference; all Windows ACL types compile fine from the framework.

title: Account Command Group
keyDecisionsMade: AccountService placed in ZapiCli.Core (not ZapiCli) so it can be tested directly from ZapiCli.Tests without referencing the exe project. Commands in ZapiCli thin-wrap AccountService.
IUserInfoService abstraction in ZapiCli.Core allows FakeUserInfoService in tests to return pre-configured emails without HTTP I/O. ZohoUserInfoService (concrete impl) lives in ZapiCli/Http/.
ZohoCorp block fires BEFORE any keychain write: ZohoCorpGuard.AssertNotZohoCorp(email) is called immediately after GetEmailAsync, before StoreTokenAsync (ADR-0005 compliance verified by unit test).
AccountOutputDto.Token is always '***' — masking is structural, not conditional. The record only exists in the output path; stored AccountEntry has no token field.

AccountAddSettings.Validate() rejects --auth-type != 'pat' with ValidationResult.Error (INVALID_ARGS exit path), and rejects missing --token for pat auth. Validates at the Spectre CLI layer before command executes.
AccountReAuthCommand is a stub that throws ZapiCliException(NotImplemented, exitCode: 1) per spec — message references v2 OAuth2 activation.
ZohoUserInfoService uses IHttpClientFactory injected via AddHttpClient() (Microsoft.Extensions.Http 10.0.0) for proper lifetime management and testability.
First account added automatically becomes IsDefault=true so subsequent commands using GetDefaultAsync work without a manual set-default call.
AccountListCommand inherits plain AsyncCommand (no generic) since it needs no settings input.

openQuestionsResolved.resolution: User-info endpoint confirmed: GET https://accounts.{domain}/oauth/user/info with Authorization: Zoho-oauthtoken {token}. 'Email' field (capital E) parsed from JSON response. Implemented in ZohoUserInfoService.
AccountAddSettings.Validate() called by Spectre before ExecuteAsync; --auth-type oauth fails immediately with ValidationResult.Error, mapped to INVALID_ARGS by framework.

issuesEncountered.issue: ValidationResult not found — missing 'using Spectre.Console;' in AccountCommands.cs (only had 'using Spectre.Console.Cli;').

title: ApiClient + Host Allowlist + api call Command
keyDecisionsMade: Security order in CallAsync: (1) FindAccount (2) ZohoCorpGuard (3) NeedsReauth check (4) Build URL (5) ValidateHost (6) GetTokenAsync (7) SendAsync (8) return response (9) throw API_ERROR on non-2xx. ValidateHost fires BEFORE GetTokenAsync to prevent credential exfiltration.

AllowedHostSuffixes is private static readonly IReadOnlyList<string> — compile-time only, not configurable at runtime (ADR-0006): .zoho.com, .zoho.eu, .zoho.in, .zoho.com.au, .zohoapis.com, .zohoapis.in.
data field in WriteSuccess is JsonElement (parsed), never a raw string. Ensures response body embeds as real JSON in the envelope.
IHttpClientFactory pattern via services.AddHttpClient<ApiClient>() with 30-second timeout.
Content-Type: application/json injected automatically for POST/PUT/PATCH; omitted for GET/DELETE.
Path normalization: prepend '/' if missing. INVALID_ARGS if --body and --body-file both set.
API_ERROR carries detail = full response body string from non-2xx responses.

title: Scope Management Command Group
keyDecisionsMade: ScopeService placed in ZapiCli.Core/Accounts/ alongside AccountService, following the established service-layer pattern. Commands thin-wrap ScopeService.
ZohoCorp block applied uniformly to all three scope operations including read-only ListScopesAsync (ADR-0005, OQ-005).

Account resolution: if --account flag provided, find by name and throw ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND if missing; else find first IsDefault=true and throw NO_DEFAULT_ACCOUNT if none. Loads root once per operation.
NeedsReauth=true is set by both AddScopeAsync and RemoveScopeAsync (but NOT ListScopesAsync — read-only).
Duplicate scope add: exits 0 without writing to disk, returns existing scopes list.
AccountEntry is a sealed record — mutations use 'with' expression creating new instances. PersistAsync replaces the matching account in the root via LINQ Select+ToList then SaveAsync.
ScopeListCommand uses AsyncCommand<GlobalSettings> directly since no extra options are needed beyond the inherited --account flag.
ScopeService registered as AddSingleton<ScopeService>() in Program.cs, matching AccountService registration pattern.

openQuestionsResolved.resolution: ZohoCorp check applied to all three scope commands including read-only scope list. Consistent with ADR-0005 uniform enforcement policy.
